description: Spec 032 (phase 19, SRD Annex J): T2's architecture and Gaussian head as a time-late model (model_kind time_late: bidirectional, every row sees the whole window), trained from scratch on generator 0.6.0 data with realistic bearing error (seed 244, configs/phase7-ranges.json). Normalisation from this dataset's train split. The evaluation job only commits the model; validation (seed 217) against tuned classical smoothers and forward trackers, and the gate (fresh seed 245), follow under a later decision.
